units.id: mission:Hai Legacy 3|dialog|448|0
units.english: As you destroy the Lightning Bug, along with Mera and her crew in it, you receive an angry hail from the Unfettered. "You completely disrespected the rules of a duel and killed one of our most prominent engineers! You will not be welcome here anymore!"
